name: Hitsuji Moko
source:
"I want to make beautiful flowers bloom."

A positive and kind second-year high school student. She has a fearless personality and doesn't discriminate between herbivores and predators. She's resistant to trouble.

The feeling that makes her turn back into a beast is "grief." Her special trait is "monohiroi."

[Translated from in-game profile]
